explanations.meaning: A feed stream carries no material, so everything downstream of it is empty.
explanations.title: Feed without a flow
explanations.why: Flow is the extensive variable of a stream. The state (temperature, pressure, composition) says what the material is; the flow says how much of it. Zero flow gives zero duties and zero products everywhere downstream, with no error.
